name: peer-the-depths-not-offered-to-non-turn-player-in-opponents-recollection
notes: Peer the Depths (6JMwc6cpRm): both players hold a copy. In player 1's recollection phase player 1 is offered it, passes, and player 2 (not the turn player) is NOT offered it, so the game proceeds straight to player 1's main phase. Pre-fix player 2 was offered it in the second response window.

rulesClauses: Activate this card only during your recollection phase.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated prereq for Peer the Depths (activateCardPrereqs["6JMwc6cpRm:0"]) was just GetCurrentPhase() === "BREC": it checked that it is a recollection phase but not WHOSE, so in the turn player's recollection response window the NON-turn player was offered Peer the Depths (decision 'OpportunityWindowSecondResponse' listing it) even though it may be activated only during its controller's own recollection phase. The prereq is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with the added GetTurnPlayer() == $player check.
